title: EXAMPLE (backend-only): reject future birth years in a pure validator
description: Template showing the ticket shape for a backend-only change. Replace every field with a real, agreed requirement before adding it. Add a pure validator in backend/app/core/factory_example.py with tests in backend/tests/test_factory_example.py. Do not edit existing files.
acceptance: A birth year later than the current year is rejected with a ValueError
The current year and earlier years are accepted
New tests fail before the validator exists and pass afterwards

api.impact: Internal validator only; the OpenAPI document must not change

acceptance: No network or external side effects
